quests.hint: This is the numbered location at a station where a specific train arrives and departs.
quests.explanation: 'Platform number' is used in UK train travel. 'Wait on the platform,' 'the train at platform six' are natural. 'Platform' is also used in tech: 'social media platform.'
quests.textToSpeak: The train to Edinburgh departs from ___ seven in approximately ten minutes.
quests.correctAnswer: The train to Edinburgh departs from platform seven in approximately ten minutes.

quests.hint: This is a printed or digital table showing when transport services run.
quests.explanation: 'Check the timetable,' 'consult the timetable,' and 'the train timetable' are natural collocations. 'Timetable' also applies to school schedules: 'the school timetable.'
quests.textToSpeak: She checked the bus ___ to find out when the last service of the day left.
quests.correctAnswer: She checked the bus timetable to find out when the last service of the day left.

quests.hint: This is a ticket that allows you to travel to a place and come back again.
quests.explanation: 'A return ticket' goes there and back; 'a single ticket' goes one way only. 'Day return' means you travel and come back on the same day. Very common in UK travel.
quests.textToSpeak: I need a ___ ticket to Oxford, please - I am coming back this evening.
quests.correctAnswer: I need a return ticket to Oxford, please - I am coming back this evening.

quests.hint: This is an advancement to a higher-level job with more pay and responsibility.
quests.explanation: 'Get a promotion,' 'earn a promotion,' and 'deserve a promotion' are natural. 'Promotional opportunity' is a formal version. 'Promote' is the related verb.
quests.textToSpeak: After three years of hard work, she was delighted to receive the ___ she deserved.
quests.correctAnswer: After three years of hard work, she was delighted to receive the promotion she deserved.

quests.hint: This means working extra hours beyond your normal contracted working time.
quests.explanation: 'Work overtime,' 'paid overtime,' and 'overtime hours' are key. 'Do overtime' is British; 'work overtime' is the standard phrase. Overtime often earns a higher hourly rate.
quests.textToSpeak: He worked ___ every evening for a month to finish the project before the deadline.
quests.correctAnswer: He worked overtime every evening for a month to finish the project before the deadline.

quests.hint: This is the formal act of leaving your job by handing in a letter of notice.
quests.explanation: 'Hand in your resignation,' 'submit your resignation,' and 'letter of resignation' are key. 'Resign' is the verb. 'Resign from a post' and 'tender your resignation' are formal.
quests.textToSpeak: She handed in her ___ after receiving an exciting offer from a rival company.
quests.correctAnswer: She handed in her resignation after receiving an exciting offer from a rival company.

quests.hint: This is a public show of artistic talent, such as music, dance, or theatre.
quests.explanation: 'Give a performance,' 'watch a performance,' and 'live performance' are key. 'Outstanding performance' and 'award-winning performance' are positive collocations.
quests.textToSpeak: The ___ by the local orchestra last Saturday was absolutely breathtaking.
quests.correctAnswer: The performance by the local orchestra last Saturday was absolutely breathtaking.

quests.hint: This is a public display of art, photographs, or other objects for people to view.
quests.explanation: 'Art exhibition,' 'attend an exhibition,' and 'hold an exhibition' are natural. 'Exhibition' is a formal display; 'expo' is an informal short form used for large events.
quests.textToSpeak: The photography ___ at the city gallery was open to the public for three weeks.
quests.correctAnswer: The photography exhibition at the city gallery was open to the public for three weeks.

quests.hint: This is all the people watching a performance or event in a theatre or concert hall.
quests.explanation: 'The audience applauded,' 'a large audience,' and 'captivate the audience' are key. 'Audience' is collective - it can take singular or plural verbs in British English.
quests.textToSpeak: The ___ rose to their feet and gave the performers a wonderful standing ovation.
quests.correctAnswer: The audience rose to their feet and gave the performers a wonderful standing ovation.

quests.hint: This is an arrangement where you pay regularly to belong to a club or organisation.
quests.explanation: 'Annual membership,' 'gym membership,' and 'renew your membership' are key. 'Membership fee' is what you pay. 'Become a member' uses the related noun form.
quests.textToSpeak: She renewed her gym ___ for another year at the special discounted rate.
quests.correctAnswer: She renewed her gym membership for another year at the special discounted rate.

quests.hint: This is a regular payment to access a service, magazine, or streaming platform.
quests.explanation: 'Monthly subscription,' 'cancel your subscription,' and 'streaming subscription' are key. 'Subscribe to' is the verb. 'Subscription fee' is the amount you pay regularly.
quests.textToSpeak: His monthly ___ to the streaming service costs him twelve pounds each month.
quests.correctAnswer: His monthly subscription to the streaming service costs him twelve pounds each month.

quests.hint: This is a reduction in the normal price of a product or service.
quests.explanation: 'Student discount,' 'offer a discount,' 'ten percent discount,' and 'discount code' are key. 'At a discount' means reduced. 'Discounted price' describes what you pay.
quests.textToSpeak: Students are entitled to a ten percent ___ on all full-price items in the store.
quests.correctAnswer: Students are entitled to a ten percent discount on all full-price items in the store.

quests.hint: This adjective describes someone who speaks a language with the ease of a native speaker.
quests.explanation: 'Fluent in English,' 'become fluent,' and 'speak fluently' are key. 'Fluency' is the noun. 'Near-native fluency' is a high-level description used in job applications.
quests.textToSpeak: After two years living in Spain, she became completely ___ in Spanish.
quests.correctAnswer: After two years living in Spain, she became completely fluent in Spanish.

quests.hint: This is the distinct way of pronouncing words, associated with a region or country.
quests.explanation: 'Foreign accent,' 'strong accent,' and 'pick up an accent' are natural. 'Accent' differs from 'dialect' - accent is pronunciation; dialect includes different words and grammar.
quests.textToSpeak: Her English was excellent, though she still had a noticeable French ___.
quests.correctAnswer: Her English was excellent, though she still had a noticeable French accent.

quests.hint: This is the total range of words a person knows and uses in a particular language.
quests.explanation: 'Build your vocabulary,' 'expand your vocabulary,' and 'wide vocabulary' are key. 'Active vocabulary' is words you use; 'passive vocabulary' is words you understand but don't produce.
quests.textToSpeak: Building a wide ___ is absolutely essential for becoming a confident speaker.
quests.correctAnswer: Building a wide vocabulary is absolutely essential for becoming a confident speaker.

quests.hint: This is a plan for spending money that helps you avoid spending more than you earn.
quests.explanation: 'Stick to a budget,' 'work within a budget,' and 'tight budget' are key. 'On a budget' means spending carefully. 'Budget airline' means a cheaper option.
quests.textToSpeak: They had to plan the holiday very carefully because their ___ was quite limited.
quests.correctAnswer: They had to plan the holiday very carefully because their budget was quite limited.

quests.hint: This verb means to have enough money to be able to buy or pay for something.
quests.explanation: 'Can't afford,' 'afford to buy,' and 'afford the rent' are natural. 'Affordable' is the adjective meaning reasonably priced. 'Within your means' is a related formal phrase.
quests.textToSpeak: He could not ___ the rent in the city centre, so he moved further out.
quests.correctAnswer: He could not afford the rent in the city centre, so he moved further out.

quests.hint: This noun refers to money you have set aside and not spent for future use.
quests.explanation: 'Build up savings,' 'dip into your savings,' and 'lifetime savings' are key. 'Savings account' is a bank account for storing money. 'Savings goal' is a target amount.
quests.textToSpeak: She put aside a small amount each month to gradually build up her ___.
quests.correctAnswer: She put aside a small amount each month to gradually build up her savings.

quests.hint: This is the distinctive taste of a particular food or drink.
quests.explanation: 'Rich flavour,' 'strong flavour,' 'natural flavour,' and 'full of flavour' are key. 'Flavour' (British) vs 'flavor' (American). 'Bland' means lacking flavour.
quests.textToSpeak: The soup had a wonderfully rich, smoky ___ from the roasted peppers.
quests.correctAnswer: The soup had a wonderfully rich, smoky flavour from the roasted peppers.

quests.hint: This is the amount of food served as one serving in a restaurant or recipe.
quests.explanation: 'Large portion,' 'small portion,' 'generous portion,' and 'portion size' are key. 'Portion control' is important in health contexts. 'A double portion' means twice the normal amount.
quests.textToSpeak: The ___ sizes at this restaurant are very generous - enough for two people.
quests.correctAnswer: The portion sizes at this restaurant are very generous - enough for two people.

quests.hint: This is a unit of a TV series - one instalment of a longer story.
quests.explanation: 'Watch an episode,' 'the latest episode,' 'a new episode,' and 'episode recap' are key. 'Binge-watch episodes' means to watch many in a row. 'Season finale' is the last one.
quests.textToSpeak: The final ___ of the series left viewers with a completely unexpected ending.
quests.correctAnswer: The final episode of the series left viewers with a completely unexpected ending.

quests.hint: This is a secret word or code that gives you access to an account or device.
quests.explanation: 'Strong password,' 'reset your password,' and 'password-protected' are key. 'Change your password regularly' is important security advice. Never share your password.
quests.textToSpeak: You need to create a strong ___ that includes numbers and special characters.
quests.correctAnswer: You need to create a strong password that includes numbers and special characters.

quests.hint: This verb means to copy data or an app from the internet onto your device.
quests.explanation: 'Download an app,' 'download a file,' and 'free to download' are natural. 'Upload' is the opposite - sending data to the internet. 'Download speed' measures how fast this happens.
quests.textToSpeak: You can ___ the app for free from the App Store or Google Play.
quests.correctAnswer: You can download the app for free from the App Store or Google Play.

quests.hint: This verb means to install the latest version of software to improve it or fix problems.
quests.explanation: 'Update your phone,' 'software update,' and 'security update' are key. 'Keep your device updated' is standard tech advice. 'Automatic updates' happen without you doing anything.
quests.textToSpeak: Make sure you ___ your software regularly to keep your device secure.
quests.correctAnswer: Make sure you update your software regularly to keep your device secure.

quests.hint: This is a formal expression of dissatisfaction about a product or service.
quests.explanation: 'Make a complaint,' 'file a complaint,' and 'lodge a complaint' are formal phrases. 'Handle a complaint' is from the company's perspective. 'Letter of complaint' is a written form.
quests.textToSpeak: She filed a formal ___ about the poor service she had received at the hotel.
quests.correctAnswer: She filed a formal complaint about the poor service she had received at the hotel.

quests.hint: This is a disagreement or argument, particularly one involving conflicting claims.
quests.explanation: 'Resolve a dispute,' 'a legal dispute,' 'a pay dispute,' and 'settle a dispute' are key. 'Dispute resolution' is the formal process of finding a solution. 'In dispute' means unresolved.
quests.textToSpeak: The two companies were involved in a lengthy legal ___ over intellectual property.
quests.correctAnswer: The two companies were involved in a lengthy legal dispute over intellectual property.

quests.hint: This is a formal agreement that ends a dispute, often involving payment.
quests.explanation: 'Reach a settlement,' 'out-of-court settlement,' and 'financial settlement' are key. 'Settle a claim' uses the verb form. 'Settlement agreement' is the formal document.
quests.textToSpeak: After months of negotiation, they finally reached a fair ___ for all parties.
quests.correctAnswer: After months of negotiation, they finally reached a fair settlement for all parties.

quests.hint: This is a short, amusing story about a real event from your own life.
quests.explanation: 'Tell an anecdote,' 'share an anecdote,' and 'funny anecdote' are natural. Anecdotes make conversations more personal and engaging. They differ from jokes because they are true stories.
quests.textToSpeak: She shared a funny ___ about getting completely lost on her first day in the city.
quests.correctAnswer: She shared a funny anecdote about getting completely lost on her first day in the city.

quests.hint: This is the quality of being funny and the ability to make people laugh.
quests.explanation: 'Sense of humour' is the standard phrase. 'British humour' is often dry and ironic. 'Humour' (British) vs 'humor' (American). 'Dark humour' means jokes about difficult topics.
quests.textToSpeak: His wonderful sense of ___ made him very popular and easy to get along with.
quests.correctAnswer: His wonderful sense of humour made him very popular and easy to get along with.

quests.hint: This is the art or skill of narrating stories in a clear and engaging way.
quests.explanation: 'Gift for storytelling,' 'great storytelling,' and 'oral storytelling' are natural. Storytelling is used in business, education, and entertainment. 'Storyteller' is the person who does it.
quests.textToSpeak: She has a remarkable gift for ___ that keeps audiences completely engaged.
quests.correctAnswer: She has a remarkable gift for storytelling that keeps audiences completely engaged.
